name: Army Educational Outreach Program High School Apprenticeship Program (HSAP)
org: U.S. Army Educational Outreach Program / U.S. Army Medical Research and Development Command

offerings.cycle_label: Annual summer apprenticeship - Maryland Army sites
offerings.summary: A paid summer apprenticeship where 10th-12th graders work in an Army laboratory alongside a scientist or engineer mentor.

age.raw: Students must be U.S. citizens and at least 16 years old to qualify for HSAP

sched.dur_raw: Students may work up to 300 hours total during June through August only

opens.raw: typically open in November for the following summer

issues: Sources describe a recurring November opening pattern but no named current cycle; the AEOP program page could not be retrieved
